text: As you can see, the keyboard has white notes and black notes. The black notes are in groups of twos and threes. The good news is there are only seven letters in music. Let's look at the group of two black notes. Here you go. C-D-E. So the three notes that surround the group of two black notes are C-D-N-E. C-D-E. C-D-E. The group of three black notes has four notes, F-G-A-B. When I was little, I used to think of the three notes like a house. F was the front door, B is the back door, and there was a baby inside that went ga-ga-ga-ga, which is G-A. So again, three black notes, F-G-A-B. F-G-A-B. So right now, go up and down the piano and find all the C-D's and E's. And after you finish that, find the F-G-A's and B's.
